::: {.project-card}
#### [Text Classification Using Embeddings for Luganda](https://github.com/EricPeter/Topic-Classification-Luganda)

Trained a topic classifier for the Luganda text corpus using Cohere embedding representations and an SVM with hyper-parameter search. Demonstrates NLP pipeline development for a low-resource Bantu language.

::: {.tech-stack}
[Python]{.tech-tag} [SVM]{.tech-tag} [Cohere API]{.tech-tag} [Scikit-learn]{.tech-tag} [Low-resource NLP]{.tech-tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### [Water Quality Data Visualisation — Kampala](https://ericpeter.github.io/msc-dataviz/)

Interactive visualisation of water quality metrics across Kampala Central Division. Surfaces spatial patterns in sanitation data to support public health analysis.

::: {.tech-stack}
[R]{.tech-tag} [Data Visualisation]{.tech-tag} [Geospatial]{.tech-tag} [Public Health]{.tech-tag}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### [Fine-Tune Alpaca for Any Language](https://github.com/alburycatalina/FHA_intro_to_coding)

Fine-tuned the Alpaca instruction-following model for multilingual language translation and topic classification tasks, exploring parameter-efficient adaptation of large language models.

::: {.tech-stack}
[Python]{.tech-tag} [LLaMA/Alpaca]{.tech-tag} [Fine-tuning]{.tech-tag} [Instruction Tuning]{.tech-tag} [NLP]{.tech-tag}
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### [Chest Opacity Detection from Ultrasound Images](https://github.com/EricPeter/MSC-DEEPLEARNING/blob/main/train.ipynb)

Deep learning pipeline for detecting chest opacities in ultrasound images — a low-cost alternative to CT scans. Addresses the clinical need for affordable, non-ionising diagnostic tools in resource-constrained settings.

::: {.tech-stack}
[Python]{.tech-tag} [PyTorch]{.tech-tag} [Deep Learning]{.tech-tag} [Medical Imaging]{.tech-tag} [Computer Vision]{.tech-tag}
:::
:::
